job.titel: Growth Tech & Agentic Commerce Advisory Consultant (all genders)
job.beschreibung:
Shape the future of commerce by helping global organizations unlock growth through AI‑driven, autonomous customer experiences. At Accenture Song, you work at the intersection of strategy, data, and technology to turn emerging agentic capabilities into measurable business impact.
Your Mission You support leading organizations in designing and scaling AI‑driven commerce transformations with a strong focus on agentic systems and Growth Tech modernization. You contribute to translating business strategy into actionable blueprints and help clients operationalize next‑generation commerce capabilities — enabling intelligent, automated customer journeys and decision‑making. At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.
Your Daily Work
Translate business and marketing challenges into agentic commerce use cases and technical enablers
Support the design of Growth Tech and Agentic Commerce strategies, including composable architectures and decisioning frameworks
Contribute to assessing existing commerce and marketing technology ecosystems and identifying gaps in AI enablement and automation
Assist in defining operating models and governance concepts around AI agents, data ownership, privacy, and consent management
Collaborate with architects and delivery teams to ensure strategic concepts translate into technically grounded execution
Who You Are
You bring 2–4 years of experience in digital strategy, marketing technology, commerce, or customer experience consulting
You have a solid understanding of Growth Tech stacks — including CDP, DXP, commerce platforms, and AI/ML or decisioning tools — and are familiar with emerging agentic AI paradigms and their application in customer‑facing contexts
You have exposure to AI‑driven use cases such as personalization, recommendations, predictive analytics, or journey orchestration, and you are comfortable working with data concepts including identity resolution, consent, and real‑time activation
You communicate clearly with stakeholders across business, marketing, data, and IT, and you are skilled at bridging business needs with technology strategy
You enjoy working in agile, cross‑functional environments and can present complex topics in a structured and compelling way
What We Offer
The opportunity to help shape one of the most forward‑looking commerce and AI topics for leading global organizations
A highly collaborative, interdisciplinary environment at the intersection of strategy, creativity, data, and technology
Access to global thought leadership, advanced learning platforms, and continuous development opportunities
Flexible working models that support your individual lifestyle and career goals
A strong team culture built on trust, diversity, and shared success
Life at Accenture Song Accenture Song is where creativity, technology, and data come together to create meaningful experiences and real business value. We work with our clients to design, build, and run solutions that drive growth and relevance in a rapidly changing world. .
The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU are the catalyst for change At Accenture, we believe that innovation starts with people. You'll work in diverse teams, bring your authentic self to work, and grow in an environment that values individuality, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Contact Us Any questions left? Feel free to contact our recruiting team at recruiting_germany@accenture.com. We look forward to your application.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
